cir_repair_policy.cir_percentage_like_numeric: normalize to canonical 0-to-1 only when source evidence unambiguously establishes the corresponding reliability percentage
cir_repair_policy.cir_percentage_string: normalize only when deterministic parsing is unambiguous and source evidence confirms the same reliability value
cir_repair_policy.conflicting_source_constraints: do not collapse conflicts; existing consistency logic remains authoritative
cir_repair_policy.missing_cir_reliability: fill from exactly one unambiguous normalized deterministic source reliability constraint
cir_repair_policy.valid_existing_canonical_value: preserve unless source-bound consistency logic establishes that it is a representation-scale mismatch

evaluation_policy.primary_development_question: Does deterministic R5 normalization correctly preserve or reconstruct explicit reliability constraints without introducing unsupported values?

non_overwrite_principle.exception: A representation-only scale correction may be performed when deterministic source evidence proves that the CIR value represents the same source reliability percentage on the wrong scale.
non_overwrite_principle.general_rule: R5 must not replace an arbitrary semantically different LLM reliability value merely to make validation pass.

invalid_source_value.condition: normalized deterministic source reliability lies outside [0,1]
invalid_source_value.operation: fail closed; do not fabricate a replacement

source_decimal.condition: explicit reliability value already within [0,1] and not expressed as a percentage

source_percentage.condition: explicit percent sign associated with reliability

problem_definition.primary_goal: Ensure explicitly stated reliability constraints are represented on the canonical 0-to-1 CIR scale without precision loss while preserving source-bound comparison operator semantics.

in_scope: normalization of percentage source values to 0-to-1
preservation of already canonical decimal reliability
source-grounded repair of missing or malformed CIR reliability
out_of_scope: qualitative reliability inference without numeric evidence
modification of R4 numeric reconciliation policy
